name: Chemically Treated Hair
description: Hair that has undergone chemical treatments such as perms, relaxers, colorings, and bleaching.
hair_texture: Varies depending on the type of chemical treatment; can range from smooth to extremely porous and frizzy.
porosity: Generally high due to the damage caused by chemicals, making it more prone to dryness and brittleness.
characteristics: Strands are more susceptible to breakage and split ends
May have a different texture after treatment compared to natural hair
common_problems: Increased porosity leading to moisture loss
Brittle strands that can snap easily
Discolored or uneven color distribution from chemical treatments
recommended_ingredients: Hydrating agents like hyaluronic acid and glycerin
Natural oils such as argan oil, jojoba oil, and avocado oil
ingredients_to_avoid: Alcohol-based products that can further dry out the hair
Sulfates which can be harsh on chemically treated hair
washing_frequency: Every 2-3 days or as needed, depending on the intensity of the treatment and daily activities.
oil_recommendation: Using oils like coconut oil or shea butter can provide deep hydration and protection between washes.

morning_routine.purpose: To moisturize the hair and reduce frizz

night_routine.action: Deep condition with a mask once or twice a week
night_routine.purpose: To restore moisture and strengthen strands

night_routine.action: Apply a lightweight oil like jojoba or argan oil to the ends of the hair
night_routine.purpose: To provide overnight hydration and protection

weekly_care: Deep conditioning treatments every week are recommended to replenish lost moisture.
heat_styling_recommendation: Use heat protectant sprays and limit the use of heat styling tools to avoid further damage.
lifestyle_tips: Protect hair from harsh weather conditions by wearing a scarf or hat
Minimize exposure to pollution and UV rays which can dry out chemically treated hair
foods_for_healthy_hair: Protein-rich foods like eggs, fish, and legumes
Fruits and vegetables rich in antioxidants such as berries, leafy greens, and oranges
common_mistakes: Over-washing or using harsh shampoos which can strip the hair of its natural oils
Neglecting deep conditioning sessions leading to dryness and breakage
dont: Do not use hot water for washing your hair as it can further damage chemically treated hair.
Do not skip regular deep conditioning treatments.

seasonal_care.summer: Use lighter, more hydrating products to protect against sun and heat. Increase oil application before going outside.
seasonal_care.winter: Focus on using richer moisturizers and deep conditioners to combat dry air. Protect hair from cold winds by wearing a scarf or hat.
seasonal_care.monsoon: Maintain regular care routines but be cautious of water damage from frequent rain. Ensure hair is thoroughly dried after washing.

compatible_hair_types: Hair that has undergone minimal chemical treatments
Hair that requires regular maintenance to maintain its condition
expert_tips: Consult a trichologist or dermatologist for personalized advice on maintaining chemically treated hair.
Regular trims can help manage split ends and maintain the overall health of your hair.
